No entries match these filters.

Every floor is one fight, then a shop, then that floor's event (the Run map shows the events). Floor 1 is always the Turtle. Every other floor rolls one fight from its own list below, all equally likely, with one rule: an encounter group you've already fought can't come up again in the same act. So floors 2 and 3 always give you one Mushrooms fight and one Slimes fight, and Act 2 never repeats a group. Each percentage is the real chance of that fight on that floor, with the rule applied.

Your difficulty changes how strong the enemies are, not which fights you can get. Difficulties share three sets of enemy stats: Base / C use set 1; B / A / S use set 2; SS / SSS use set 3. Pick yours with the Difficulty buttons and every HP and damage number on the page switches; on SSS the act bosses also carry a relic.

Click a fight for its enemies, their stats and moves, and the reward. Fight names are the game's internal group names; the game itself doesn't show a name. Read from the act builder's code and the stage table of this build.
